import os, sys, struct, fcntl, termios, tty, time
d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]))
tag = sys.argv[1]
def put(name, data, mode='wb'):
    tmp = os.path.join(d, tag + name + '.tmp')
    with open(tmp, mode) as f: f.write(data)
    os.replace(tmp, os.path.join(d, tag + name))
try: tty.setraw(0)
except Exception: pass
put('.argv', open('/proc/self/cmdline', 'rb').read())
put('.pid', str(os.getpid()).encode())
put('.ppid', open('/proc/%d/cmdline' % os.getppid(), 'rb').read())
rows, cols = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]
put('.ready', ('%d %d\n' % (rows, cols)).encode())
buf = b''
while True:
    try: chunk = os.read(0, 4096)
    except OSError: break
    if not chunk: break
    buf += chunk
    while b'\n' in buf or b'\r' in buf:
        i = min([x for x in (buf.find(b'\n'), buf.find(b'\r')) if x >= 0])
        line, buf = buf[:i], buf[i+1:]
        if line == b'': continue
        if line == b'fork':
            import signal
            if os.fork() == 0:
                os.setsid()
                for sg in (signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT): signal.signal(sg, signal.SIG_IGN)
                put('.grand', str(os.getpid()).encode())
                while True: time.sleep(1)
            continue
        if line == b'size':
            r, c = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]
            with open(os.path.join(d, tag + '.sizes'), 'a') as f: f.write('%d %d\n' % (r, c))
        else:
            with open(os.path.join(d, tag + '.input'), 'ab') as f: f.write(line + b'\n')

exec 2>/dev/null

P=$PWD
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$P/gate"; exec 9<> "$P/gate"
nap() { read -t "${1:-0.05}" -u 9 _junk; }
export BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR=$P/state SHELL=/does-not-select-the-default-shell
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR"
PY=/usr/bin/python3; CH=$P/child.py; LY=$P/layout.py
SESS=()
snap_tree() { /usr/bin/find "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" -mindepth 1 -printf '%P %y %m\n' 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -v '^\.layout\.lock ' | /usr/bin/sort; }
snap_procs() { local c l r out=; for c in /proc/[0-9]*; do [[ ${c#/proc/} == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; [[ -r $c/stat ]] || continue; read -r l < "$c/stat" 2>/dev/null || continue; r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && continue; out+="${c#/proc/} "; done; echo "$out" | /usr/bin/tr ' ' '\n' | /usr/bin/sort -n | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' '; }
settle_procs() { local before=$1 i now; for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do now=$(snap_procs); [[ $now == "$before" ]] && return 0; nap 0.03; done; return 1; }

extras() { local before=" $1" p st pp pc; for p in $(snap_procs); do [[ $before == *" $p "* ]] && continue; st=; read -r st < /proc/$p/stat 2>/dev/null; st=${st##*) }; pp=${st#* }; pp=${pp%% *}; pc=; read -r pc < /proc/$pp/comm 2>/dev/null; echo "extra-process: comm=$(< /proc/$p/comm) state=${st%% *} parent-comm=$pc cmdline=$(/usr/bin/tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/cut -c1-70)"; done; }
BASE=$(snap_procs)
await() { local i; for ((i=0;i<400;i++)); do [[ -e $1 ]] && return 0; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
pidgone() { local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -d /proc/$1 ]] || return 0; if read -r l < /proc/$1/stat 2>/dev/null; then r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && return 0; fi; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
cleanup() { local s f i; for s in "${SESS[@]}"; do screen kill "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; for f in "$P"/*.pid; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; pidgone "$(<"$f")"; done; for ((i=0;i<250;i++)); do [[ $(snap_procs) == "$BASE" ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# probe TAG SESSION TARGET: ask the child on TARGET for its TIOCGWINSZ; echoes "rows cols"
probe() { local tag=$1 sess=$2 tgt=$3 n; n=0; [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes ]] && n=$(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes"); screen send-keys "$sess" -p "$tgt" size >/dev/null 2>&1; local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes && $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes") -gt $n ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; /usr/bin/tail -n1 "$P/$tag.sizes" 2>/dev/null; }
# geom SESSION WIN PANE: "rows cols" the layout reports for the pane
geom() { screen pane-list "$1" "$2" | while read -r idx r c rows cols rest; do [[ $idx == "$3" ]] && echo "$rows $cols"; done; }
yes_if() { if "$@"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }

BADLONG=$(printf 'n%.0s' $(seq 1 120))
before_tree=$(snap_tree); before_procs=$(snap_procs)
bad() { local label=$1; shift; "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1; local rc=$?; echo "$label rc-nonzero=$([[ $rc != 0 ]] && echo yes || echo no) tree-unchanged=$([[ $(snap_tree) == "$before_tree" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; }

bad name-dot screen run -n . -- "$PY" "$CH" N1
bad name-dotdot screen run -n .. -- "$PY" "$CH" N2
bad name-slash screen run -n 'a/b' -- "$PY" "$CH" N3
bad name-escape screen run -n '../escape' -- "$PY" "$CH" N4

bad missing-win-create screen win-create nosuch w2 -- "$PY" "$CH" M1
bad missing-pane-split screen pane-split nosuch 0 h -- "$PY" "$CH" M2
bad missing-pane-resize screen pane-resize nosuch 0 0 "0 0 10 10"
bad missing-pane-kill screen pane-kill nosuch 0 0
bad missing-win-switch screen win-switch nosuch 0
bad missing-win-kill screen win-kill nosuch 0
bad missing-send-keys screen send-keys nosuch hello
bad missing-kill screen kill nosuch
bad missing-state screen state nosuch
bad missing-pane-select screen pane-select nosuch 0 0
settle_procs "$before_procs"; echo "processes-unchanged=$([[ $(snap_procs) == "$before_procs" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; extras "$before_procs"
echo "children-never-started=$([[ ! -e $P/N0.ready && ! -e $P/N3.ready && ! -e $P/N10.ready && ! -e $P/M1.ready && ! -e $P/M2.ready ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "no-escape-dir=$([[ ! -e $P/escape && ! -e $BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR/../escape ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
SESS+=(goodname_1.x)
screen run -n goodname_1.x -- "$PY" "$CH" G1 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "valid-name-control rc=$?"

put('.ready', ('%d %d\n' % (rows, cols)).encode())
buf = b''
while True:
    try: chunk = os.read(0, 4096)
    except OSError: break
    if not chunk: break
    buf += chunk
    while b'\n' in buf or b'\r' in buf:
        i = min([x for x in (buf.find(b'\n'), buf.find(b'\r')) if x >= 0])
        line, buf = buf[:i], buf[i+1:]
        if line == b'': continue
        if line == b'fork':

                while True: time.sleep(1)

            r, c = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]

exec 2>/dev/null

P=$PWD
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$P/gate"; exec 9<> "$P/gate"
nap() { read -t "${1:-0.05}" -u 9 _junk; }
export BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR=$P/state SHELL=/does-not-select-the-default-shell
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR"
PY=/usr/bin/python3; CH=$P/child.py; LY=$P/layout.py
SESS=()
snap_tree() { /usr/bin/find "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" -mindepth 1 -printf '%P %y %m\n' 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -v '^\.layout\.lock ' | /usr/bin/sort; }
snap_procs() { local c l r out=; for c in /proc/[0-9]*; do [[ ${c#/proc/} == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; [[ -r $c/stat ]] || continue; read -r l < "$c/stat" 2>/dev/null || continue; r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && continue; out+="${c#/proc/} "; done; echo "$out" | /usr/bin/tr ' ' '\n' | /usr/bin/sort -n | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' '; }
settle_procs() { local before=$1 i now; for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do now=$(snap_procs); [[ $now == "$before" ]] && return 0; nap 0.03; done; return 1; }

extras() { local before=" $1" p st pp pc; for p in $(snap_procs); do [[ $before == *" $p "* ]] && continue; st=; read -r st < /proc/$p/stat 2>/dev/null; st=${st##*) }; pp=${st#* }; pp=${pp%% *}; pc=; read -r pc < /proc/$pp/comm 2>/dev/null; echo "extra-process: comm=$(< /proc/$p/comm) state=${st%% *} parent-comm=$pc cmdline=$(/usr/bin/tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/cut -c1-70)"; done; }
BASE=$(snap_procs)
await() { local i; for ((i=0;i<400;i++)); do [[ -e $1 ]] && return 0; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
pidgone() { local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -d /proc/$1 ]] || return 0; if read -r l < /proc/$1/stat 2>/dev/null; then r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && return 0; fi; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
cleanup() { local s f i; for s in "${SESS[@]}"; do screen kill "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; for f in "$P"/*.pid; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; pidgone "$(<"$f")"; done; for ((i=0;i<250;i++)); do [[ $(snap_procs) == "$BASE" ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# probe TAG SESSION TARGET: ask the child on TARGET for its TIOCGWINSZ; echoes "rows cols"
probe() { local tag=$1 sess=$2 tgt=$3 n; n=0; [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes ]] && n=$(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes"); screen send-keys "$sess" -p "$tgt" size >/dev/null 2>&1; local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes && $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes") -gt $n ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; /usr/bin/tail -n1 "$P/$tag.sizes" 2>/dev/null; }
# geom SESSION WIN PANE: "rows cols" the layout reports for the pane
geom() { screen pane-list "$1" "$2" | while read -r idx r c rows cols rest; do [[ $idx == "$3" ]] && echo "$rows $cols"; done; }
yes_if() { if "$@"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }

SESS+=(foc)
screen run -n foc -- "$PY" "$CH" A >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/A.ready"
screen pane-split foc 0 h -- "$PY" "$CH" C >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/C.ready"
screen win-create foc w2 -- "$PY" "$CH" B >/dev/null 2>&1; await "$P/B.ready"
input() { local f=$P/$1.input; [[ -e $f ]] && /usr/bin/tr '\n' ',' < "$f"; echo; }
star() { screen pane-list foc "$1" | while read -r idx r c rows cols rest; do [[ $rest == '*' ]] && echo "$idx"; done | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' '; }
waitin() { local i; for ((i=0;i<200;i++)); do [[ -e $P/$1.input ]] && /usr/bin/grep -q -- "$2" "$P/$1.input" && return 0; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
screen win-switch foc 0 >/dev/null 2>&1
screen pane-select foc 0 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "select-0: star=[$(star 0)] rc=$?"
screen send-keys foc k-to-A >/dev/null 2>&1; waitin A k-to-A
screen pane-select foc 1 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "select-1: star=[$(star 0)]"
screen send-keys foc k-to-C >/dev/null 2>&1; waitin C k-to-C
echo "keys: A=$(input A) C=$(input C) B=$(input B)"
screen pane-select-dir foc 0 1 L >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "select-dir-L-from-1: star=[$(star 0)]"
screen send-keys foc dirL >/dev/null 2>&1; waitin A dirL
screen pane-select-dir foc 0 0 R >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "select-dir-R-from-0: star=[$(star 0)]"
screen send-keys foc dirR >/dev/null 2>&1; waitin C dirR
echo "keys: A=$(input A) C=$(input C)"
screen win-switch foc 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; screen send-keys foc k-to-B >/dev/null 2>&1; waitin B k-to-B
screen win-switch foc 0 >/dev/null 2>&1; screen send-keys foc back-in-0 >/dev/null 2>&1; waitin C back-in-0
echo "window-switch: B=$(input B) C-has-back-in-0=$([[ $(input C) == *back-in-0* ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
before_a=$(geom foc 0 0); before_c=$(geom foc 0 1)
screen pane-resize foc 0 1 '0 41 9 31' >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "resize: rc=$? reported=$(geom foc 0 1) child=$(probe C foc 0:1)"
screen pane-swap foc 0 0 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "swap: rc=$? A-reported=$(geom foc 0 0) A-child=$(probe A foc 0:0) C-reported=$(geom foc 0 1) C-child=$(probe C foc 0:1)"
echo "swap-exchanged-geometry: A-got-old-C=$([[ $(geom foc 0 0) == '9 31' ]] && echo yes || echo no) C-got-old-A=$([[ $(geom foc 0 1) == "$before_a" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"
screen pane-resize-dir foc 0 0 D 2 >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "resize-dir-D2: rc=$? reported=$(geom foc 0 0) child=$(probe A foc 0:0)"
for d in R L U; do screen pane-resize-dir foc 0 0 $d 1 >/dev/null 2>&1; rc=$?; echo "resize-dir-$d: rc=$rc child-equals-reported=$([[ $(probe A foc 0:0) == "$(geom foc 0 0)" ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; done

cases.purpose: BSCR frames built by an independent encoder: a 1 MiB payload decodes, a frame declaring 1 MiB+1 with its full payload present is rejected (so the bound, not truncation, rejects it), as are truncated headers, bad magic, bad version, bad type, a declared length larger than the supplied payload and a 4 GiB-1 declaration.
cases.oracle: Independent Python struct-based encoder following the documented layout (magic BSCR, version 1, type 1-3, 32-bit big-endian length, payload); expectations come from the documented 1 MiB bound.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout; the +1 frame carries every declared byte, so its rejection cannot be a truncation.

files.body.sh:
exec 2>/dev/null

P=$PWD
/usr/bin/mkfifo "$P/gate"; exec 9<> "$P/gate"
nap() { read -t "${1:-0.05}" -u 9 _junk; }
export BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR=$P/state SHELL=/does-not-select-the-default-shell
/usr/bin/mkdir -m 700 "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR"
PY=/usr/bin/python3; CH=$P/child.py; LY=$P/layout.py
SESS=()
snap_tree() { /usr/bin/find "$BASHSCREEN_STATE_DIR" -mindepth 1 -printf '%P %y %m\n' 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/grep -v '^\.layout\.lock ' | /usr/bin/sort; }
snap_procs() { local c l r out=; for c in /proc/[0-9]*; do [[ ${c#/proc/} == "$BASHPID" ]] && continue; [[ -r $c/stat ]] || continue; read -r l < "$c/stat" 2>/dev/null || continue; r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && continue; out+="${c#/proc/} "; done; echo "$out" | /usr/bin/tr ' ' '\n' | /usr/bin/sort -n | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' '; }
settle_procs() { local before=$1 i now; for ((i=0;i<100;i++)); do now=$(snap_procs); [[ $now == "$before" ]] && return 0; nap 0.03; done; return 1; }

extras() { local before=" $1" p st pp pc; for p in $(snap_procs); do [[ $before == *" $p "* ]] && continue; st=; read -r st < /proc/$p/stat 2>/dev/null; st=${st##*) }; pp=${st#* }; pp=${pp%% *}; pc=; read -r pc < /proc/$pp/comm 2>/dev/null; echo "extra-process: comm=$(< /proc/$p/comm) state=${st%% *} parent-comm=$pc cmdline=$(/usr/bin/tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline 2>/dev/null | /usr/bin/cut -c1-70)"; done; }
BASE=$(snap_procs)
await() { local i; for ((i=0;i<400;i++)); do [[ -e $1 ]] && return 0; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
pidgone() { local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -d /proc/$1 ]] || return 0; if read -r l < /proc/$1/stat 2>/dev/null; then r=${l##*) }; [[ ${r%% *} == Z ]] && return 0; fi; nap 0.02; done; return 1; }
cleanup() { local s f i; for s in "${SESS[@]}"; do screen kill "$s" >/dev/null 2>&1; done; for f in "$P"/*.pid; do [[ -e $f ]] || continue; pidgone "$(<"$f")"; done; for ((i=0;i<250;i++)); do [[ $(snap_procs) == "$BASE" ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# probe TAG SESSION TARGET: ask the child on TARGET for its TIOCGWINSZ; echoes "rows cols"
probe() { local tag=$1 sess=$2 tgt=$3 n; n=0; [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes ]] && n=$(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes"); screen send-keys "$sess" -p "$tgt" size >/dev/null 2>&1; local i; for ((i=0;i<300;i++)); do [[ -e $P/$tag.sizes && $(/usr/bin/wc -l < "$P/$tag.sizes") -gt $n ]] && break; nap 0.02; done; /usr/bin/tail -n1 "$P/$tag.sizes" 2>/dev/null; }
# geom SESSION WIN PANE: "rows cols" the layout reports for the pane
geom() { screen pane-list "$1" "$2" | while read -r idx r c rows cols rest; do [[ $idx == "$3" ]] && echo "$rows $cols"; done; }
yes_if() { if "$@"; then echo yes; else echo no; fi; }

$PY - "$P" <<'PYEND'
import struct, sys
d = sys.argv[1]
def w(name, data): open(d + '/' + name + '.frame', 'wb').write(data)
def hdr(t, n, magic=b'BSCR', ver=1): return magic + bytes([ver, t]) + struct.pack('>I', n)
M = 1024 * 1024
w('ok-pty', hdr(1, 5) + b'hello')
w('ok-query', hdr(2, 3) + b'abc')
w('ok-control', hdr(3, 0))
w('ok-1mib', hdr(1, M) + b'x' * M)
w('over-1mib-plus1-full-payload', hdr(1, M + 1) + b'x' * (M + 1))
w('over-4gib-minus1-small-payload', hdr(1, 0xffffffff) + b'x' * 16)
w('over-2mib-full-payload', hdr(2, 2 * M) + b'y' * (2 * M))
w('trunc-header-5', hdr(1, 0)[:5])
w('trunc-header-9', hdr(1, 0)[:9])
w('empty', b'')
w('bad-magic', hdr(1, 3, magic=b'BSCX') + b'abc')
w('bad-version-0', hdr(1, 3, ver=0) + b'abc')
w('bad-version-2', hdr(1, 3, ver=2) + b'abc')
w('bad-type-0', hdr(0, 3) + b'abc')
w('bad-type-4', hdr(4, 3) + b'abc')
w('len-larger-than-payload', hdr(1, 10) + b'abcd')
w('len-larger-than-payload-by-one', hdr(1, 4) + b'abc')
PYEND
decode_rc() { local name=$1; screen remote-frame decode < "$P/$name.frame" >"$P/dec.out" 2>/dev/null; local rc=$?; echo "$name rc=$([[ $rc == 0 ]] && echo 0 || echo nonzero) out=$(/usr/bin/head -c 200 "$P/dec.out" | /usr/bin/head -n 2 | /usr/bin/tr '\n' ' ')"; }
for n in ok-pty ok-query ok-control ok-1mib over-1mib-plus1-full-payload over-4gib-minus1-small-payload over-2mib-full-payload trunc-header-5 trunc-header-9 empty bad-magic bad-version-0 bad-version-2 bad-type-0 bad-type-4 len-larger-than-payload len-larger-than-payload-by-one; do decode_rc "$n"; done
echo "frame sizes: 1mib-plus1-file=$(/usr/bin/stat -c %s "$P/over-1mib-plus1-full-payload.frame") (header 10 + 1048577)"
/usr/bin/rm -f "$P"/*.frame "$P/dec.out"
files.child.py:
import os, sys, struct, fcntl, termios, tty, time
d = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(sys.argv[0]))
tag = sys.argv[1]
def put(name, data, mode='wb'):
    tmp = os.path.join(d, tag + name + '.tmp')
    with open(tmp, mode) as f: f.write(data)
    os.replace(tmp, os.path.join(d, tag + name))
try: tty.setraw(0)
except Exception: pass
put('.argv', open('/proc/self/cmdline', 'rb').read())
put('.pid', str(os.getpid()).encode())
put('.ppid', open('/proc/%d/cmdline' % os.getppid(), 'rb').read())
rows, cols = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]
put('.ready', ('%d %d\n' % (rows, cols)).encode())
buf = b''
while True:
    try: chunk = os.read(0, 4096)
    except OSError: break
    if not chunk: break
    buf += chunk
    while b'\n' in buf or b'\r' in buf:
        i = min([x for x in (buf.find(b'\n'), buf.find(b'\r')) if x >= 0])
        line, buf = buf[:i], buf[i+1:]
        if line == b'': continue
        if line == b'fork':
            import signal
            if os.fork() == 0:
                os.setsid()
                for sg in (signal.SIGHUP, signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT): signal.signal(sg, signal.SIG_IGN)
                put('.grand', str(os.getpid()).encode())
                while True: time.sleep(1)
            continue
        if line == b'size':
            r, c = struct.unpack('HHHH', fcntl.ioctl(0, termios.TIOCGWINSZ, bytes(8)))[:2]
            with open(os.path.join(d, tag + '.sizes'), 'a') as f: f.write('%d %d\n' % (r, c))
        else:
            with open(os.path.join(d, tag + '.input'), 'ab') as f: f.write(line + b'\n')
files.scan.py:
import os, sys
ch = sh = 0
for p in os.listdir('/proc'):
    if not p.isdigit(): continue
    try: a = open('/proc/%s/cmdline' % p, 'rb').read().split(b'\0')
    except OSError: continue
    if len(a) > 1 and a[0] == b'/usr/bin/python3' and a[1].endswith(b'child.py'): ch += 1
    if a and os.path.basename(a[0]) in (b'sh', b'dash', b'-sh', b'busybox'): sh += 1
print('children=%d shells=%d' % (ch, sh))
for tag in sys.argv[1:]:
    f = open(sys.argv[0].rsplit('/', 1)[0] + '/' + tag + '.ppid', 'rb').read().split(b'\0')
    script = f[f.index(b'-c') + 1] if b'-c' in f else b''
    print('%s broker-script-carries-no-user-text=%s' % (tag, 'yes' if b'child.py' not in script and b'SENT' not in script and b'touch' not in script else 'no'))
